description: Returns a document's text: PDFs page by page, Excel sheets as CSV lines under sheet headings, CSV as it is. Long files page through offset/next_offset — keep asking until next_offset is null. Only for files in the vault's documents folder; a statement pasted into the chat is already in front of you. The text stays on this machine and in this conversation; never copy an account or card number out of it into the vault — the validator refuses them. Debit lines are charges; credit lines are money in, written with direction "in"; only movements between the owner's own accounts are skipped.
name: read_document
title: Read a document
